summary: Adds the managed-k8s SLA observability bounded context under microservices/managed with pure golden-signal/error-budget calculations, a transport-neutral snapshot port, an in-memory adapter, and an app service that consumes the control-plane-host status seam without live Prometheus/Kubernetes dependencies.
nonclaims: No live Prometheus scraping or Kubernetes/kube-rs adapter is implemented in this slice.
No production SLO attainment or measured runtime availability is claimed.
No tenant-quota decision surface is changed.

findings: Small additive bounded context: four crates plus minimal docs/catalog/manifest rows; no live runtime or Kubernetes client introduced.
Golden-signal summary shape follows availability/provisioning-latency/error-budget control-plane practice while honestly deferring production metrics collection.
Tests reject malformed observations and unknown clusters with typed errors rather than panics or synthesized success.
Callers can ingest direct snapshots or call ingest_from_control_plane against the settled ControlPlaneProvisioning status port.
Targeted nextest, clippy -D warnings, fmt, architecture, data-class, honest-claims, and design/spec maturity validations passed.
Rejected adding live Prometheus/Kubernetes adapter in this slice; in-memory/test adapter keeps the seam honest and verifiable.
Tenant and cluster identifiers remain tenant-scoped DTO fields with data_class annotations; unknown/malformed clusters fail closed.
Kernel calculations are deterministic O(1) arithmetic over pre-aggregated window counters; no network or unbounded scan on the hot path.
No regulated tenant workload data, kubeconfig, secrets, or live provider payloads are stored; docs state no production SLO evidence claim.
In-memory adapter and app tests cover healthy, degraded, unknown cluster, control-plane-port read, and serialization slug determinism.
DTO exposes availability basis points, provisioning latency SLO state, and error-budget burn basis points.
Reserved facet not applicable to this scoped implementation.
Clean-architecture dependency flow is kernel <- api <- adapter/app; app adapts sibling control-plane-host API without an api-to-api dependency.

Live Prometheus/Kubernetes ingestion is deferred behind the SLA observability port.

architect_blockers_resolved: Catalog data_classes_owned now includes TENANT_SCOPED for SLA observability catalog rows.
In-memory observation store now keys by ClusterKey tuple/newtype instead of slash-joined String.

Poisoned in-memory lock now maps to SlaObservabilityError::Store with regression coverage.
